Ordinance No. 19-26 Adopted 12/12/19 AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF LABELLE, FLORIDA, CALLING FOR AND ORDERING A BINDING REFERENDUM TO BE HELD IN THE CITY OF LABELLE ON MARCH 17, 2020; TO DETERMINE WHETHER A MAJORITY OF THE ELECTORS VOTING IN SUCH REFERENDUM ARE IN FAVOR OF CERTAIN PROPOSED CHARTER AMENDMENT; ESTABLISHING THE DATE OF THE REFERENDUM FOR THE CHARTER AMENDMENT TO BE HELD ON MARCH 17, 2020; REQUESTING THAT THE HENDRY COUNTY SUPERVISOR OF ELECTIONS CONDUCT THE ELECTION IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE APPLICABLE LAWS AND REGULATIONS; PROVIDING BALLOT LANGUAGE; DIRECTING THAT THE NOTICE OF ELECTION BE PREPARED AND PUBLISHED; PROVIDING FOR INCLUSION IN THE CHARTER; PROVIDING FOR SEVERABILITY, SCRIVENER'S ERRORS AND AN EFFECTIVE DATE.
